factual_methodology.summary: The Reuters market-close Treasury yields (10-year 4.948%, 2-year 4.647%) are attached to both references [9] and [10]. Reference [10] is the Treasury par-yield-curve series, which reports 4.92% and 4.63% for 20 November and uses indicative bid-side quotations at or near 3:30 p.m. The report does not distinguish these series or explain the differing observations. Separately, the PT-BR ECB exposure sentence omits the source's 'US technology' scope, changing the population described.

evidence_traceability.summary: Reference [10] does not reproduce the exact 4.948%/4.647% market-close observations attached to it. The U.S. Treasury daily par curve for 20 November shows 4.92% (10-year) and 4.63% (2-year), while Reuters [9] reports 4.948% and 4.647%. The report must cite Reuters alone for those market-close values or separately label the Treasury par-curve series and its different observation time/method. ECB FSR page 81 states that non-banks' holdings in US technology and AI-related firms account for 16%-26% of equity investments; PT-BR line 95 says only 'empresas relacionadas à IA', omitting US technology holdings.

Reference [16], NBS, Investment in Fixed Assets from January to October 2026, 17 November 2026, note below table
issues.evidence: The cited NBS release reports fixed-asset investment -8.1%, manufacturing investment -2.9%, infrastructure investment -5.1% and non-governmental fixed-asset investment -11.4%. Its table explicitly states: 'The growth rates in this table are not adjusted for price factors.' The current EN/PT-BR text and table disclose the comparable-basis and January–October period but omit this non-price-adjusted basis. The report places these investment rates beside real industrial value-added growth (+4.8%) and high-tech manufacturing growth (+17.6%), so readers cannot audit that the series use different price bases. 'Comparable basis' refers to year-on-year statistical comparability; it does not mean price-adjusted.
issues.required_correction: In both editions, explicitly state that the cited fixed-asset investment growth rates are not adjusted for price factors and must not be read as real-volume growth or compared one-for-one with real industrial value-added growth. Add the qualification to the China table's Basis column for all four investment rows. Preserve the January–October observation period and comparable-basis wording. Update pending producer_checks.source_vintage, evidence_traceability and revision_scope to record the price basis and the distinction from real output measures. Do not invent or substitute a deflator.
